Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

evaluatr 0.1.0

  • Initial GitHub release.
  • secure_model_validation(): retrieves model from private GitHub repo and computes shuffled predictions locally.
  • eval_performance(): discrimination, calibration, and utility metrics with bootstrap CIs and diagnostic plots.
  • Supports binary outcome models.
  • Subgroup analysis via the by argument in both main functions.

Developed by Joie Ensor, Ben Van Calster, Lasai Barreñada, Laure Wynants, Benjamin I. Perry.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1.
